(103)༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog ngam rdzong snyan brgyud kyi man ngag rtsa ba tshe ring skor gsum gyi gzhung bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (103)༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog ngam rdzong snyan brgyud kyi man ngag rtsa ba tshe ring skor gsum gyi gzhung bzhugs so/// /

(104)༄༅// na mo gu ru we/ gangs khrod grub rigs rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa de nyid 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba sman lung chu bar gyi dben gnas su chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ chu pho 'brug gi lo'i dbyar zla ra ba'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad kyi nam gung yol tsa na/ sha za'i ḍā ki nī mched lngas gtsor byas pa'i snang srid kyi lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul ston pa'i skabs mi 'jigs pa khong du chud cing rtogs pa gding du gyur pa'i mgur/ yang yul la mtshan gsol ding ma brin// khe tshol 'du ba'i tshong 'dus te// mi rgya bod gnyis kyi 'grim sa yin// gangs mtho la gnyan pa'i tshe ring ma// ri bkra shis shel gyi zur phud can// lha sman rgyal mo'i thu ba la// 'brog dbyar sa sman lung mi zer ram// sa khol du bres pa'i chu bar du// khyed stong phrag brgyad cu bgegs kyi tshogs// lha gnas gzhan 'phrul man chad nas// sa 'og lto 'phye yan chod la// lkugs pa'i klu dang nam mkha' lding*// dri za srul po mi'am ci// lto 'phye grul bum srin po'i gdon// ro langs (105)gnod sbyin 'byung po rnams// re re'i ming nas brjod mi lang*// bsam gyis mi khyab mang po'i tshogs// khyad par 'jigs pa'i srin mo lnga// mi ngal mi snyan ngag tu smra// tshe 'di nas pha rol 'gro dgos zer// nga 'chi ba kho nas 'jigs 'jigs nas// sems 'chi med gnyug ma'i ngang du sbyangs// 'khor ba rang grol gzhi yi gnad// snying po'i don la ngo sprod bgyis// nang rig brten med gcer bu 'di// 'gyur ba dwangs sangs lta ba'i gdengs// 'od gsal stong par blo thag chod// nga skye 'chi gnyis la nyam nga med// nga mi khoms brgyad la 'jigs 'jigs nas// mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms// skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo phug gtad// las rgyu 'bras chos la nan tan bskyed// thabs byang chub sems kyis rgyud sbyangs pas// bag chags sgrib pa'i rgyun lam bcad// snang ba ci snang sgyu mar rtogs// ngan song gsum la nyam nga med// nga glo bur tshe la 'jigs 'jigs nas// lam rtsa dang rlung la rten 'brel bsgrigs// gnad (106)bse ba gsum la sbyangs pa yis// tshogs drug gi snang ba 'gags pa'i tshe// chos sku ngo sprod kyi gding yod de// shes rgyud tshangs pa'i lam nas thon// sems skye med chos kyi dbyings su 'pho// ngas da lta shi yang nyam nga med// lar khyed cag 'jig rten lha ma srin// skye 'gro'i tshe srog nyul ba rnams// nga sgyu ma gzugs kyi phung po 'di// mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te// lar cis kyang mi stongs 'dor ba la// 'dre khyod la dgos na su dga' khyer// spyir 'gro ba yongs kyi glud du gtog

/dgos drin can pha ma'i don du bsngo// lus sha khrag mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas// khyed dga' mgu rangs shing tshim gyur nas// sngon chad 'khor ba thog med kyi// bu lon 'brel thag chod par gyis// lan chags sha 'khon bral bar mdzod// sems 'gyu ba dngos med stong pa de// 'dre khyod bas ngas kyang mthong ba med// dmyal khams bco brgyad dgrar langs kyang*// 'jigs so snyam na nga la sdig /nga stong nyid nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// 'khrul pa'i de nyid shes pa'i phyir// 'dre khyod la nyam nga'i 'jigs pa med// lar thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul te// e ma khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos// med bzhin snang ba ngo mtshar che// zhes bzhengs pa na der tshogs pa'i lha 'dre thams cad mos shing 'dun par gyur te/ slar yang mkha' 'gro chen mo lngas snying gtam sros su bsnyad pa'i glu dbyangs phul ba na/ rje btsun rin po ches lan gsungs pa/ spyir phyi rol bdud kyi rigs lha 'dre'i bar du gcod pa thams cad nang rnam par rtog pa sems kyi nyer len las byung ba khyed cag zer ba ltar bden na nged rnal 'byor pa'i lugs kyis bar chad la skyon du mi blta ste/ ltas dang cho 'phrul gyi rnam pa ci byung yang*/ de nyid bka' drin can nam 'dod (107)thog tu 'khyer te las dang po pa'i gang zag le lo can rnams la brtson 'grus kyi lcag 'debs/ gnyen po glo bur du skye zhing rig pa'i ngar 'don/ 'di nyid kyis lus ngag dge sbyor la bskul nas bsam gtan myur du rgyud la skye ba'i rgyu byed la/ lam goms shing brtan pa thob pa rnams la ni dran pa ye shes kyi gsos 'debs/ rig pa 'od gsal gyi mdangs 'don zhing nang ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyong*/ de la brten nas byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye zhing lam gyi bogs gong nas gong du 'byin par byed do// dus de'i gnas skabs na bdud rigs chos skyong du zhal 'gyur zhing chos skyong sprul skur mthong bas rkyen ngan dngos grub tu 'babs/

bar chad lam du bslangs/ rnam rtog chos skur 'char// skyon yon tan tan du grol te thun mong lam gyi mthun rkyen thams cad khyed cag gis sgrub par byed do// mthar thug shes bya'i gshis la lha dang 'dre gnyis ka ma grub ste/ re dogs spong len gyi mtshan ma rang sar grol bas/ 'khrul pa gzhi med du rtogs shing 'khor ba phyag rgya chen por shar la de la glo bur gyi rnam par rtog pa dbyings su thim pa'i tshe chos sku 'du 'bral med pa zhes ming du btags so gsungs nas/ de dag gi don tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ rgyal ba'i zhing khams 'dzam gling 'dir// sangs rgyas gnyis pa ltar grags shing*// mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi// cod pan gtsug gi nor bu ltar// kun gyis bkur zhing mchod pa'i gnas// snyan pa'i ba dan sgra dbyangs kyis// phyogs rnams kun tu khyab pa de// rje mnga' bdag mai tri ma lags sam// de nyid zhabs kyi padmo la// gus pas brten cing bcud 'thungs pas// lta ba'i yang rtse phyag rgya che// mtha' bral gnyug ma'i don rtogs shing*// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs te// skyon rnams kun gyi ma gos pa// (108)bde gshegs sprul pa mi gzugs can// skyes mchog mar pa 'di skad gsung*// phyi snang ba ji ltar snang lags kyang*// ma rtogs dus na 'khrul snang ste// yul gyi zhen pas 'ching bar byed// rtogs pa rnams la sgyu mar snang*// yul snang sems kyi grogs su 'char// mthar thug don la snang ma myong*// skye med chos skur dag go gsung*// nang 'gyu ba yid kyi rnam shes 'di// ma rtogs dus na ma rig pa// las nyon mongs kun gyi gzhi rtsa yin// rtogs na rang rig ye shes te// dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs par 'byung*// mthar thug don la ye shes med// chos rnams zad sar skyol lo gsung*// nyer len gzugs kyi phung po 'di// ma rtogs dus na 'byung bzhi'i lus// na tsha sdug bsngal de las 'byung*// rtogs na lha sku zung 'jug ste// tha mal zhen pa zlog par byed// mthar thug don la lus med de// sprin bral mkha' ltar dag go gsung*// gdon gnod sbyin pho mo'i snang ba 'di// ma rtogs dus na bdud yin te// tho 'tsham bar du gcod par byed// rtogs na bgegs rnams chos skyong ste// sna tshogs dngos grub khyed las 'byung*// mthar thug don la lha 'dre med// rnam rtog zad sar skyol lo gsung*// spyir theg pa'i mthar thug gsang sngags kyi// rnal 'byor bla med rgyud nas kyang*// khams 'dus pa rtsa yi rten 'brel gyis// phyi rol 'dre gzugs mthong bar gsungs// de rang snang rdzun du ma shes shing*// bden no snyam na shin tu rmongs// nga sngon chad rmongs pas mgo bo 'khor// ma rig 'khrul pa'i tshang du zhugs// phan gnod kyi lha 'dre bden par bzung*// da grub thob rje yi bka' drin gyis// 'khor 'das dgag sgrub med par go

/cir snang phyag rgya chen por shar// 'khrul pa gzhi med du rtogs pa des// rig pa'i chu zla rnyogs pa dwangs// (109)'od gsal gyi nyi ma sprin dang bral// ma rig mun pa mtha' nas sangs// rmongs pa'i mgo 'khor yal nas thal// yin lugs zhig nang nas 'char gyin gda'// lar 'drer 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rin po che// gzhi skye med kyi gsal 'debs ngo mtshar che// zhes bla ma'i gsung tshad mar 'dzin cing*/ gdams ngag la nges shes skyes pa'i mgur de rnams rje btsun gyis bzhengs pa las/ der tshogs pa thams cad shin tu gus pas ci gsung bka' bzhin du bsgrub par g.yar dam blangs te so so rang rang gi gnas su gyes so// 'di ni lam thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa phyag rgya chen po dang*/ nā ro gsang spyod kyi dgongs pa rnams gcig tu dril ba'i rdo rje'i glu ste/ don rgyas par snga phyir 'byung ba'i phyag rgya chen po dang*/ ras chung snyan brgyud dang 'brel ba'i dpal nā ro pa'i gsang spyod kyi khrid yig rnams las shes par bya'o// zhus lan gyi skor dang po'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ lo de'i phyi ma chu mo sbrul gyi lo'i dbyar ra ba'i tshes bcu gcig gi nub mo// slar yang zhing skyong ḍā ki'i dbang mo mched lnga spyan sngar lhags te byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par gsol ba na/ snod brtag pa las brtsams te thun mong gi lam rim rdo rje'i mgur du bzhengs pa/ dpal do nub srod kyi gung thun la// phyogs shar nas 'od cig mdangs gsal bas// smag khri mun mtha' nas sangs pa de// chu shel zla ba ma lags sam// zla zer mdangs kyi rta zhon nas// lus 'od du 'khyil zhing 'ong ba de// khyed 'jig rten ḍā ki ma lags sam// chu bo lo ta han gyi klung 'gram na// rang byung gi dben gnas nyams dga' ba// chu dbar dpal gyi pho brang na// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i smyon pa zhig /(110)'byung ba'i lus la tsha grang med// ngo tsha mi shes gcer nyal mkhan// yid la mi byed snying po'i don// skad cig ma yengs sgom du med// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid lta ba de// mi la sgom chen ma lags sam// nga spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ras pa dang*// khyed rdzu 'phrul can gyi bud med lnga// glu phar cig tshur gcig len pa de// sngon chad smon lam btab par nges// khyod da ci phan chad ngo ma shes// da ni ngo shes glo ba dga'// na ning sos kyi da tsam na// srid pa'i bud med dbang mo che// gtso mo khyed kyis g.yo g.yo nas// 'jig rten srid pa'i lha 'dre tshogs// dpung bzhi dmag gi ru dar phyar// 'thab rtsod g.yul ngo bshams nas kyang*// gdug rtsub mtshon gyi char 'bebs shing*// mi nga la bar gcod ci ma byas// nga snang ba sems su thag chod cing*// sems nyid stong par shes pa'i phyir// 'khrul snang bgegs kyi cho 'phrul la// ya nga bag tsha byed ma myong*// spyir yang khyed cag mthong tsam gyis// kho bo shin tu mi bzod pas// rang dbang med pa'i snying rje skyes// dkar po'i chos kyi 'jam char phab// khyed slar yang mos shing gus par 'gyur// ngo gcig lo yi ding sang na// mtshar sdug ldan pa'i bud med lnga// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag 'tshal nas// ya mtshan che ba'i spyan gzigs drangs// rtse gcig gus pa'i thal sbyar nas// ngag snyan pa'i tshig gis zhu 'bul ba// byang chub sems kyi sprin phung las// bdud rtsi'i chos char phob cig skad// khyed de tsam gus pa'i sems yod na// mi nga yi cod pan nor bu la// rtsa gsum padma'i gdan steng na// rje 'gran gyi do med bka' drin can// sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā de// dag pa longs sku'i tshul du bzhugs// khong thugs rje sprin (111)bral zla ba las// dri med dkar po'i 'od 'phros pas// gdul bya'i snying gi ku mu da// mdzes pa'i me tog kha phye nas// rtogs pa'i ze'u 'bru g.yo bar byed// de mthong ngam 'jig rten mig sgyur ma// ma mthong sgrib pa che ba'i phyir// sngon chad 'khor ba thog med kyi// kha na ma tho lci ba rnams// mthol zhing bshags pa ma byas na// zab mo bshad pa'i snod mi rung*// khyed sngon chad mi bsrun thod rgal che// ngan spyod g.yo sgyu goms pa'i phyir// phyin chag gtsigs la dbab pa yod// khas blangs dam bca' len spyod na// bstan pa don gzhan ma lags te// dge dang mi dge'i las rnams la// rgyu 'bras dag par ma bsams na// ngan song sdug bsngal mi bzod pas// phra zhing phra ba'i rnam smin la// bag yod dran pas zin kyang 'tshal// 'dod yon skyon du ma bltas shing*// zhen pa nang nas ma log na// 'khor ba'i btson ra mi sgrol bas// thams cad sgyu mar shes pa'i blos// kun 'byung gnyen po bsten yang 'tshal// 'gro drug drin can pha ma la// byas pa drin du mi bzo na// theg pa dman par gol ba'i skyon// de phyir brtse ba chen po yis// byang chub sems la bslab kyang 'tshal// legs bshad de cho nyan spyod na// theg chen lam gyi rnal 'byor ma// 'o skol ming sring lta sbyong mthun// gnas skabs bgrod pa'i lam yang gcig

/yon tan phrin las mthar phyin pa'i// dag pa mngon dga'i zhing khams der// 'o skol 'dzom par gdon mi za// zhes gdams so/// /de ltar bka' stsal ba na slar yang nan du gsol ba btab pa'i ngor byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa stsal te rang gi gnas su song bar gyur to// 'di ni skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim snying por dril ba ste don rgyas par dwags po rin po ches mdzad pa'i lam rim thar (112)rgyan sogs las shes par bya'o// yang zla ba de'i phyi ma'i mtshams/ bcu gcig gi nub mor 'jig rten mig sgyur gyi ḍā ki nī mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan sngar lhags te/ mchod pa'i rnam grangs du mas mchod pa dang chab cig /rje btsun khyed rang gi thugs las byon pa'i rtogs tshad/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa mthar thug lam gyi bskyol sa 'di las med ces pa/ nges don gyi chos zhig don 'dir tshogs pa'i lha ma srin rnams la gsung bar zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ de'i dus su rje btsun gyis rtogs tshad lta ba'i mgur/ gnas lugs nges don 'ba' zhig tu gdams pa 'di rnams yin gsung nas mgur bzhengs pa/ yang bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams na// yul ya mtshan che ba'i ding ma brin// zong 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i tshong 'dus na// la sman btsun mi la dpal mgon pa// sba brjid gangs kyi rgyal mo la// tshe g.yung drung brtan pa'i zur phud can// de mtshan snyan bkra shis tshe ring ma// ri na bun 'thibs kyi g.yon zur na// 'brog sman g.yang gangs kyis bskor ba de// sman lung chu dbar ma lags sam// gnas de na rtse gcig nyams len pa// nga mi la rnal 'byor mi zer ram// mi nga la sngon chad mtho 'tsham zhing*// co 'dri bzhad gad byed pa de// khyed cag 'jig rten lha ma srin// shin tu dregs shing mi bsrun pa// rnal 'byor yongs kyi drod nyul ba// de ring 'dir tshogs ma lags sam// 'dang sang dgun zla snga ma la// yid 'phrog bu mo mdzes ma lnga// bla med mchog tu sems bskyed de// ci 'dod dngos grub khas blangs nas// mi snang mkha' la 'phur nas thal// de yang ngo mtshar khyed cag lnga// dgung do nub dkar gsal zla mdangs la// sprul pa'i bud med bzhin bzang ma// gar sgyur sgeg mo'i cha byad can// lhab lhub (113)dar gyi na bza' dang*// do shal rgyan gyis mdzes pa yi// gtso mo khyod kyis mdongs gsol nas// sde brgyad dregs pa'i lha ma srin// sde dang dpung dang dmag mi dang*// rigs mthun 'khor gyi tshogs bcas rnams// nam mkha' khengs pa'i mchod sprin dang*// ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas dang*// sna tshogs rol mo phul nas kyang*// nges don dgongs pa zhu ba de// khyed snang srid lha 'dre ma lags sam// tshig de skad zlo na rna bar snyan// ngag bden pas bkrol na kun kyang nyon// da ca co ma zer glu 'di nyon// spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la// 'dod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs yod// ngar 'dzin lta ba tha dad yod// de dag spyod tshul sna tshogs yod// gzhi bdag tu lta ba shin tu mang*// khyed blo dman rnams kyis bsam pa dang*// bstun nas kun mkhyen sangs rgyas kyis// thams cad yod ces gsungs pa yin// don dam bden pa'i dbang du ni// bgegs pas sangs rgyas nyid kyang med// sgom pa po med bsgom bya med// bgrod byas dang lam rtags med// 'bras bu sku dang ye shes med// de phyir mya ngan 'das pa med// ming dang tshig gis btags pa tsam// khams gsum brtan dang g.yo bar bcas// gdod nas ma grub skye ba med// gzhi med lhan cig skyes pa med// las dang las kyi rnam smin med// de phyir 'khor ba'i ming yang med// mthar thug don la de ltar gda'// e ma sems can med gyur na// dus gsum sangs rgyas ci las byung*// rgyu med 'bras bu mi srid pas// kun rdzob bden pa'i dbang du ni// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// thams cad yod ces thub pas gsungs// yod pa dngos por snang ba dang*// med pa stong pa'i chos nyid gnyis// ngo bo dbyer med ro gcig pas// rang rig gzhan rig yod min te// thams cad zung 'jug yangs pa yin// de ltar rtogs pa'i mkhas pa yis// rnam shes ma mthong ye shes mthong*// sems can ma mthong sangs rgyas mthong*// chos can ma mthong chos nyid mthong*// de las snying rje shugs 'byung ste// stobs dang mi 'jigs gzungs (114)la sogs// sangs rgyas yon tan gang yin pa// nor bu rin chen tshul du 'byung*// de rnal 'byor nga yi rtogs tshad yin// khyed 'dir tshogs lha 'dre'i rna lam du// chos zab mo bas kyang bon sgra snyan// a bhi ra yi rgyal khams su// mkhas pa bas kyang smyon pa brin// dur khrod nyul ba'i wa spyang rnams// seng ge'i nga ros 'jigs shing skrag

/'ga' zhig skal ldan yod srid na// 'di don thos pas grol bar 'gyur// lar mi nga la dga' ba'i nyams zhig skyes// bso dga' yo skyed do the le rgyal// zhes pa'i mgur de skad gsungs nas de dag gi don bshad pa/ spyir ston pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed cig gsungs pa de dag thams cad gdul bya gang zag gi blo ngo dang bstun nas theg pa sna tshogs su bstan pa yin gyis/ mthar thug bskyal sa gcig las med/ gcig po de gzhi chos nyid ma bcos pa yin/ de yin lugs shes pas mi grol te/ lam sbyangs pa mngon du 'gyur dgos/ de la lam gyi ngo bo stong pa snying rje zung 'jug yin/ lam gyi bgrod tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa ji snyed cig yod kyang mdor hril gyis dril na thabs shes zung 'jug gam/ bden gnyis dbyer med du khyer 'tshal lo// ces gsungs pas/ ḍā ki ma lngas mngon par bstod cing smon lam gyi glu phul/ rje btsun chen pos kyang rdo rje theg pa'i sgor bcug par mdzad do// tshul 'di ni zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma chen po'i dgongs don gsal bar ston pa'i rdo rje'i glu ste/ rgyas par thams cad mkhyen pa padma dkar pos mdzad pa'i gzhung 'di'i 'grel pa nges don grub pa'i shing rta sogs las rtogs par bya'o// zhus len gyi skor gnyis pa'o/ ༈ /gsum pa ni/ slar yang zla ba de'i phyi ma ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu gcig gi dgongs mo rje btsun rin po che sman btsun chen mo rang gi bsti gnas su gdan drangs shing*/ (115)yul der dmar thabs chen po shor ba'i rkyen gyis gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma bro 'tshal ba la rjes su 'dzin par mdzad pas dbugs dbyung zhing rang gnas su phebs/ slar zla ba de'i nyi shu dgu la bkra shis tshe'i dbang phyug mched lnga spyan sngar lhags te/ nan tan chen pos gsol ba btab pa las/

yum rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i lugs su dbang bskur zhing byin rlabs mdzad de/ de'i dus su bar do gnad kyi 'phrang sgrol sku gsum ngo sprod kyi gdams pas dag pa bde chen gyi zhing du bgrod lugs 'di rnams mgur du bzhengs pa/ 'dzam gling snying po rgya gar yul// gtsug lag khang chen bi kra ma// rig pa'i 'byung gnas de nyid kyi// byang sgo srung ba'i paṇḍi ta// mi yi seng ge 'gran zla med// rgol ba ngan pa'i glad 'gems phyir// gyad stobs po che yi dpe dang mtshungs// bka' rgyud sde bzhi la ma rmongs shing*// mchog thun mong dngos grub brnyes pa de// rje nā ro paṇa chen ma lags sam// de nyid sras kyi mchog gyur pa// pha dka' ba spyad pa'i thugs rus can// lho brag mar pa lo tsā zhes// mtshan yongs su grags so 'brug sgra ltar// rje bka' drin can gyi zhal snga nas// shākya thub bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// mi rnams tshe thung longs spyod dbul// bdud rigs bar chod mang ba'i phyir// dus yun ring sdod pa'i long med cing*// shes bya'i mtha' la chod dus med// rgyud sde'i mkhyen rgya mi 'tshal bas// bu sgrub pa snying por longs shig gsungs// mi ngas kyang le lo ma bgyis te// rje gsungs pa'i bka' bzhin rjes su mnyan// gnas ri khrod bas mtha' bsnyegs nas kyang*// lus dka' thub spyad de bsgoms pa las// nyams cung zad rgyud la skyes pa yod// sems lhan ne gtod cig skal bzang ma// spyir 'o skol 'gro drug sems (116)can la// gzhi bar do'i chos drug shes kyang 'tshal// lam srid pa gsum gyi 'byung 'jug gis// gnas khams gsum 'khor bar yang yang 'khyams// 'phrang 'jur med gsum gyi so mtshams su// shul ring mgron po mi gsum la// mdza' bshes gnyen gyi bya ra bas// dga' brod gdong nas bsu ba yong*// bsu ma de dang ma mjal na// dgra sdang gshed ma'i phyag brnyan pas// bya spyod blta myul 'ong ste mchi// dpung ded dpon gsum dang ma 'grogs na// rgyus med 'jigs bcas tshong pa rnams// ma mthong 'jigs pa'i skung sa nas// lung ston bdud kyi pho nya gsum// thar med jag pas lam na bsgugs// 'dra min sprul pa'i gzugs 'dzin cing*// slu ba'i tshig gis yid bsgyur te// lam gol log par khrid nas kyang*// bdun phrag bdun pa yan chad du// snang mun srid pa'i bar do ru// tsha grang sdug bsngal nyams su myong*// de nas las kyi rjes 'brangs te// slar yang 'khor ba'i btson rar 'jug

/da btson ra de las thar 'dod na// da res 'khor 'das bar do ru// gnas lugs ngo sprod phyag rgya che// gzhi lta ba gtan la 'bebs kyang 'tshal// snang ba skye shi'i bar do ru// rig pa sems kyi rtsal sbyang phyir// lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis la 'bad kyang 'tshal// rang bzhin lam gyi bar do ru// gnyug ma ye shes ngos gzung phyir// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag bsgom yang 'tshal// rmi lam gnyid kyi bar do ru// bag chags lam du bsgyur ba'i phyir// 'od gsal sgyu lus sbyang yang 'tshal// tha ma srid pa'i bar do ru// sku gsum mngon du gyur nas kyang*// zhing khams gsum du bgrod kyang 'tshal// gal te mngon du ma gyur na// skye gnas brgyud pa'i bar do ru// smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar nas// rgyu 'bras mi bslu'i rten 'brel gyis// dal (117)'byor 'dzom pa'i lus thob cing*// snga ma'i las 'phro sad nas kyang*// lam gyi rtogs pa mthar phyung ste// ring por mi thogs de nyid du// grol bar 'gyur ba the tshom med// khyed ya mtshan che ba'i bud med lnga// rtse gcig gus pas bka' nyan zhing*// don ched du bskyar te zhu ba la// mi kho bos bar do'i gdams ngag bshad// rje lho brag mar pa'i thugs phyung yang*// gnad de las zab pa yod re skan// zhes mgur du bzhengs shing*// de'i don lhug par gsungs pa bzhin bzang ma rnams gzhi gsum du mi khom pa brgyad kyi 'du byed kyis thang chad cing lam srid pa gsum nas yun ring bshar bas lus ngal dub tu gyur pa shul ring gi mgron po gsum yod de// gdams ngag kyang yod la nyams su yang blangs pa'i gang zag dang*// gdams ngag yod la nyams su ma blangs pa'i gang zag dang*/ gdams ngag kyang med la nyams su yang ma blangs pa'i gang zag go /snga ma de ni srid pa'i lam dang*/ 'jigs pa'i 'phrang dang*/ bdud kyi skungs la sogs pa ya nga ba gang yang med de/ bsgoms pa'i gnad kyis grol ba'i phyir ro// phyi ma ni skye bo tha mal pa dang mtshungs te/

ya nga ba dang bcas pa'i 'phrang de rnams su zhugs nas rang bzhin gyi bdud kyis khrid de/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su skye 'chi bar ma chad par zo chun khyud mo lta bur longs spyod pa'o// bar ma de la sngar bstan pa'i ya nga ba dang bcas pa'i lam 'phrang gi dogs pa de dag bsal zhing bar chod bdud kyi phyag brnyan brtags pa'i gdams ngag yod de khyed la mi 'gyur ba'i dad pa dang*/ zab mo la mos pa'i shes rab dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha yod na/ khams dang dbang po'i dus tshod dang sbyar la khad kyis bsnyad par bya/ da res sku gsum mngon 'gyur gyi so mtshams lag len du bstan na lam 'chi ba'i (118)srid pa la 'gyu ba/ gnad gcod kyi 'phrang phyi nang 'byung ba'i skye mched rim gyis thim pa'i rjes la/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba mtha' dag las rnam par grol ba'i nam mkha' sprin med pa la nyi zla shar ba lta bu chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba ngo bo stong pa nyid kyi gnas lugs ma bcos pa ji lta ba dus der 'char bas de ka 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku yin te de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shes par byed pa la/ da lta bla ma dam pas ngo sprod pa'i gnas lugs lta ba'i don go ba dang*/ mtshon byed lam gyi 'od gsal sbyang 'tshal/ lam srid pa bar ma do la sngon byung yid kyi gzugs can las kyi gshed mas 'tshe ba'i 'phrang*/ snang mun 'od kyi bar do ru// dbang po kun tshang thogs pa med cing las kyi rdzu 'phrul 'od dang ldan pa'i lus shig yod pa de ka bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ zung 'jug lha'i snang ba sgyu ma lta bur bzhengs nas bag chags snga ma'i lhag lus sbyong ba yin pas/ de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shes par byed pa la da lta bskyed pa'i rim pa lha'i sku la dmigs pa gsal ba dang*/ mtshon byed lam gyi sgyu ma rmi lam sbyang 'tshal/

lam srid pa tha ma rig pa las kyi rlung gis rang dbang med par skyod pa'i 'phrang dri za mngal gyi skye gnas 'tshol ba'i dus der pho mo sbyor ba byed pa la chags sdang skye bas sngar gyi gdams ngag dran pa'i gnad kyis/ rang nyid bde stong gi nyams dang mi 'bral bar gnyen po'i rtsal mthar phyin pas las kyi snang ba mi 'char zhing*/ dus phyin chad bsam nas skye ba len pa de ka skye ba sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku yin te/ de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shes par byed pa la da lta grol lam gtum mo drod kyi ye shes skyes pa dang*/ chags lam las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dbang gsum pa rdzogs pa'i don nyams su myong (119)khas phrag dog mig ser sbyang 'tshal/ mdor hril gyis dril ba la 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du 'gyur lugs kyi dus dang sa mtshams de ltar shes par bgyid 'tshal/ rje lho brag mar pa'i thugs kyi bcud phyung ba snyan brgyud don gyi ngo sprod thabs lam gnad kyi mthar thug kyang de las med do// rnal 'byor pa nga yi dgongs pa'i bzhed lugs blo yid ches kyi gding 'phral nyams su blang rgyu de las med pas/ bzhin bzang ma khyed kyis kyang de ltar shes par gyis la nyams su longs shig gsungs pa las/ mig sgyur ma de lnga'i nang nas gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma thabs lam zab mo don gyi ngo sprod la shin tu mos shing dad par gyur pa des/ yang zhabs spyi bor blangs nas rje btsun la dus 'di nas bzung ste skye gnas thams cad kho mo phyi bzhin du 'brang zhing las kyi phyag rgya bgyid par 'tshal bas/ bar do ngo sprod kyi gnad de rnams kyi nyams dang rtogs pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du thugs la gdags 'tshal/ zhes zhu ba nan tan du gsol nas/ phyag dang bskor ba lan grangs du mar byas te/ slar khong rang gi gnas su song skad do// 'di'i don rgyas par chos drug gi bar do'i khrid dang*/

khyad par rgyal ba yang dgon pas mdzad pa'i bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi gzhung lhan thabs dang bcas pa rnams las shes par bya'o// zhus lan gyi skor gsum pa'o// de ltar tshe ring skor gsum du grags pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'di rnams mdo sngags kyi gdams pa mtha' dag gi don gyi bcud phyungs te/ gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi cha rkyen tshang la ma nor bar bstan pa yin te/ skor dang pos lam thun mong ba dang*/ khyad par phyag rgya chen po'i dgongs don/ bogs 'don gsang spyod dang bcas pa bstan/ gnyis pas bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi gdams ngag skyes bu gsum gyi lam (120)rim dang*/ dpal mai tri pa'i bzhed pa ltar dbu ma zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa'i dgongs pa bstan/ gsum pa mthar thug rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi lam gnad thun mong ma yin pa bsre 'pho gnad kyi mtshams sbyor bar do rnam pa drug gi sgo nas bstan pa yin la/ 'di rnams las 'phros te/ gdams ngag nā ro chos drug la rgyas par ras chung snyan brgyud/ 'bring po ngam rdzogs pa'am zhi ba 'od kyi snyan brgyud/ bsdus pa dwags po snyan brgyud gsum du grags pa'i lam 'bring po'i chos skor rnams byung ba yin pas rgyas par de dag gi gzhung dang man ngag gi yi ge las shes par bya'o// shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/// /
